name: Render converts 30% of Strength into melee haste rating natively (#985)
contract: Render 704951 (Knight of Xoroth War level-40 passive, CharacterAdvancement 9262; granted by the War specialization tree, see knight-spec-tree-free-nodes) reads 'Level 40 Passive. Increases your melee haste rating by $s1% of your Strength.' in the live client Spell.dbc.

Spell.dbc: one SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effect, aura 220 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT, BasePoints 29 DieSides 1 (30), EffectMiscValue 131072 = 1 << CR_HASTE_MELEE (17), EffectMiscValueB 0 = STAT_STRENGTH, target caster. EquippedItemClass is -1, so its EquippedItemSubClassMask 1378 imposes no weapon requirement.

Player::UpdateRating adds CalculatePct(GetStat(MiscValueB), amount) for every aura 220 whose MiscValue has the rating's bit and applies the melee haste rating through ApplyRatingHaste; Player::UpdateStats refreshes those ratings when Strength changes. The mechanic is native, so no per-spell script is needed.

Expected: learning Render raises only melee haste rating (not ranged or spell haste rating) by 30% of Strength, shortens the melee attack time, follows a Strength change, and unlearning restores the baseline.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
SETUP no specialization granted Render already
SETUP Strength is large enough for a 1-point rating rounding tolerance
The aura carries the authored 30 percent
CONTRACT melee haste rating rises by 30% of Strength
CONTROL ranged haste rating is untouched
CONTROL spell haste rating is untouched
CONTRACT the haste rating shortens the melee attack time
Raise Strength with Mighty Strength (+50 Strength)
CONTRACT the rating follows the Strength change at 30%
Melee haste rating returns to baseline
Melee attack time returns to baseline (float round trip)
